extracted.name: Smoked Eggs
extracted.description: Smoked eggs are bursting with delicious smoky flavor and will take any hard-cooked egg dish to new heights. They are easy to make in the smoker.
ingredient_lines: 6 large fresh raw eggs in the shell
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat a smoker grill to 225 degrees F (110 degrees C). Add wood chips according to manufacturer's directions.
Place whole eggs directly on the grate of the preheated smoker. Cook, without turning, for 2 hours, maintaining an even temperature.
Transfer eggs to a plate and allow to cool completely before peeling. Season with salt and pepper.
